post.description: Suspend the account and end every session; 409 for oneself, an admin, a banned one.
Clear the ban; the user signs in again. 409 when the account is not banned.
Credit (> 0) or claw back (< 0); a clawback below zero is 409 ``balance_too_low``.

Revoke this session and clear the cookie.

Idempotent: unknown or already-revoked tokens succeed silently, which is also why it
takes no ``Idempotency-Key``.

Rotate-on-use; the reuse trip-wire lives in the service.

Keyless: rotation is inherently single-use, a replay is the attack it detects. Must
write nothing before :func:`refresh_session` — on reuse the service commits its
burn-down, which would commit any earlier pending write too.

Verify the callback with Steam and open a session.

The signed ``return_to`` must carry the nonce of this browser's ``csmarket_oid``
cookie (login-CSRF defence). The nonce is single-use: the cookie is cleared on every
outcome, so a failure is retried from ``/auth/steam/start``.

Keyless by design: replaying an OpenID assertion is refused by Steam itself
(``check_authentication`` succeeds once), so an ``Idempotency-Key`` adds nothing.

401.description: Not verified, or not started in this browser

get.description:
Send the browser to Steam, bound to this browser by a fresh nonce.

``return_to`` is the app's own callback page; realm is the app's origin. Both come
from settings — the query only picks which app, so the redirect cannot be aimed
anywhere else. The nonce goes into ``return_to`` (which Steam signs) and into the
``csmarket_oid`` cookie; :func:`steam_complete` requires the two to match.
get.summary: Begin a Steam sign-in (302 to steamcommunity.com)

get.description: Profile, roles and trade-link state.

patch.description: Partial update; replays a stored response for a repeated ``Idempotency-Key``.

put.description: Parse, require that it is this account's own link, save. No external call.

post.description:
Advisory check of the saved link (AGENTS §11 carve-out).

Keyless on purpose: it writes only the derived verdict of a link the user already
saved, and re-running it is the intended use; the 10-minute cache makes a repeat free.

Click's ``/complete`` (``action=1``): Click debited the customer; credit the top-up.

Authenticated by the MD5 ``sign_string``; always HTTP 200. Idempotent on our
``merchant_prepare_id`` (a replay is ``-4``), so no ``Idempotency-Key``.

schema.title: Response Click Complete Api V1 Payments Click Complete Post

post.description:

Authenticated by the MD5 ``sign_string``; always HTTP 200 (see the module docstring).
Idempotent on Click's ``(click_trans_id, service_id)``, so no ``Idempotency-Key``.

schema.title: Response Click Prepare Api V1 Payments Click Prepare Post

post.description:
One Payme Merchant API call: ``{"method", "params", "id"}`` → ``result`` or ``error``.

Authenticated by HTTP Basic (``Paycom:<key>``) before the body is read; always HTTP 200
(see the module docstring). Idempotent on Payme's transaction ``id``, so no
``Idempotency-Key``. The request ``id`` is echoed (``null`` when absent or unparsed).

schema.title: Response Payme Merchant Api V1 Payments Payme Merchant Post

May this top-up be paid? Answers its amount in soʻm for Uzum's app to prefill.

Basic auth before the body is read; HTTP 400 on any error (see the module docstring).
Writes nothing, so no ``Idempotency-Key``.
Uzum debited the customer: credit the top-up once (a replay is 10016).

Register Uzum's transaction (``CREATED``) and hold a payment attempt.

Idempotent on Uzum's ``transId`` (a replay is 10010), so no ``Idempotency-Key``.
Cancel a held transaction or reverse a confirmed top-up (a replay is 10018).
The transaction's status and times (a plain read).
